scope: Local exploration and separate held-out confirmation. Original zr6 and 5bc are exact source-pinned reference arms. No-feints is a DEV-only causal diagnostic.

B.label: zr6 plus two independent strong planners

originals_per_fixture: Every arm shares the exact pregame map, seat, token, rival order, rival sources/configs, and per-seat RNG seed.
endpoint: Opponents outscored per full game, range 0–3, with tied opponents worth one half. Whole maps are the bootstrap units within each of the two fixed generator strata.
validation: Independent CPU referee agrees throughout each trace. Actual callbacks honor 2s first/200ms regular, legal inputs and immutable public observations. Each original is replayed with fresh actors and the same private per-seat RNG. Real time is preserved. Faults or replay mismatches invalidate the stage; all attempted outcomes and original tapes remain recorded. No selective rerun.
freshness: Exclude known local campaign maps and records, prior 1,000-game screen, reconstructed branch EXT1/EXT2 holdouts, and all DEV maps from FINAL. Only the chosen DEV source enters FINAL. Opponent fields are fixed, so the inference is conditional on those fields.
